with seed as (
  select * from jsonb_to_recordset($json$[{"slug":"navidad","name":"Preventa Navideña","icon":"✼","imageUrl":"/manus-storage/navidad_c98eafac.jpg","sortOrder":0},{"slug":"nubes","name":"Nubes temáticas","icon":"☁","imageUrl":"/manus-storage/nubes-portada-premium_f843e2ec.jpeg","sortOrder":1},{"slug":"placas","name":"Placas circulares","icon":"○","imageUrl":"/manus-storage/placas_f2df896b.jpg","sortOrder":2},{"slug":"cuadros","name":"Cuadros infantiles","icon":"▣","imageUrl":"/manus-storage/cuadros_0fdc2e1c.jpg","sortOrder":3},{"slug":"combo","name":"Combo completo","icon":"✦","imageUrl":"/manus-storage/combo_d729a5a2.jpg","sortOrder":4},{"slug":"nube-cuadros","name":"Nube + cuadros","icon":"☁","imageUrl":"/manus-storage/nube-cuadros_4f013700.jpg","sortOrder":5},{"slug":"nube-cuadros-lampara","name":"Nube + cuadros + lámpara","icon":"☼","imageUrl":"/manus-storage/combo_d729a5a2.jpg","sortOrder":6},{"slug":"nombre-cuadros","name":"Nombre + cuadros","icon":"Aa","imageUrl":"/manus-storage/nube-cuadros_4f013700.jpg","sortOrder":7},{"slug":"packs","name":"Packs lamparitas","icon":"✧","imageUrl":"/manus-storage/instalacion-real-nubes_eee88aa5.jpg","sortOrder":8},{"slug":"lamparas","name":"Lámparas decorativas","icon":"☼","imageUrl":"/manus-storage/instalacion-real-nubes_eee88aa5.jpg","sortOrder":9},{"slug":"liquidacion","name":"Liquidación","icon":"%","imageUrl":"/manus-storage/cuadros_0fdc2e1c.jpg","sortOrder":10},{"slug":"fe-espiritualidad","name":"Fe y espiritualidad","icon":"✦","imageUrl":"/manus-storage/fe-espiritualidad_546155f2.png","sortOrder":11},{"slug":"alcancias","name":"Alcancías y regalos","icon":"♡","imageUrl":"/manus-storage/placas_f2df896b.jpg","sortOrder":12},{"slug":"didacticos","name":"Didácticos","icon":"ABC","imageUrl":"/manus-storage/cuadros_0fdc2e1c.jpg","sortOrder":13}]$json$::jsonb)
  as x(slug text, name text, icon text, "imageUrl" text, "sortOrder" integer)
)
insert into public.categories (name, slug, icon, image_url, active, sort_order)
select name, slug, icon, "imageUrl", true, "sortOrder" from seed
on conflict (slug) do update set name = excluded.name, icon = excluded.icon, image_url = excluded.image_url, active = true, sort_order = excluded.sort_order, deleted_at = null;
